_comment: DO NOT DELETE, and do not grow this file. This project has no Node and no npm — dependencies and tasks live in deno.json. This file exists for exactly one reason: `overrides` is the only mechanism that can force a transitive npm dependency's version, and deno.json has no equivalent. Deno does read it (verified: without this file, cross-spawn resolves to 6.0.5). Delete it the day vite-plugin-elm stops pinning a vulnerable node-elm-compiler, and not before.
_comment_overrides: vite-plugin-elm (3.0.1, latest) hard-pins node-elm-compiler@5.0.6, which hard-pins cross-spawn@6.0.5 exactly — carrying the ReDoS advisory with no upstream release to move to. 6.0.6 is the patch for exactly that, same major, so force it here.
